queries:
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_all
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
),
station_avg AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
),
margins AS (
  SELECT s.observstation,
         s.avg_usage,
         s.avg_usage - o.avg_all AS margin
  FROM station_avg s, overall o
  WHERE s.avg_usage > o.avg_all
)
SELECT observstation, avg_usage, margin
FROM margins
WHERE margin >= (
  SELECT MIN(margin)
  FROM (SELECT margin FROM margins ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 10)
)
ORDER BY margin DESC;
WITH station_avg AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS overall_avg FROM station_avg
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.avg_usage,
       s.avg_usage - o.overall_avg AS margin
FROM station_avg s, overall o
WHERE s.avg_usage > o.overall_avg
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH sig_tel AS (
  SELECT t.observstation, t.bandusagepct
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
  WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM sig_tel
)
SELECT
  st.observstation,
  AVG(st.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
  AVG(st.bandusagepct) - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall
FROM sig_tel st
CROSS JOIN overall o
GROUP BY st.observstation, o.overall_avg
HAVING AVG(st.bandusagepct) > o.overall_avg
ORDER BY excess_over_overall DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_all
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
),
station AS (
  SELECT t.observstation AS observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN signals s ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.observstation
)
SELECT st.observstation,
       st.avg_usage,
       st.avg_usage - o.avg_all AS margin
FROM station st
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE st.avg_usage > o.avg_all
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;
